strategies.example: ISO 9001 says 'shall document', FAA Part 21 says 'may use electronic records' (different retention)
vera_approach: 2. Identify the actual delta (not just phrasing)
strategies.vera_output: 🟡 **CONFLICTING REQUIREMENTS** — ISO 9001 requires [X], FAA allows [Y]. Recommend: Adopt ISO's stricter approach. Flag for auditor confirmation.

strategies.example: Procedure says 'changes approved by dept head', ISO says 'shall establish change control board'
vera_approach: 1. Check if 'dept head' IS the CCB in their org
3. If no, flag as practice gap
strategies.vera_output: 🔴 **PRACTICE GAP** — Your procedure names a single approver, but ISO requires board-level change control. This will fail audit.

strategies.example: Procedure A says 'retain 7 years', Procedure B says 'retain 10 years'
vera_approach: 1. Check which document is more recent
2. Check which document is more specific
strategies.vera_output: 🟡 **DOCUMENT INCONSISTENCY** — Your procedures specify different retention periods. Recommend: Standardize to the longer period (10 years) for safety.

precedence_rules: Regulatory (FAA/EASA) > Industry Standard (ISO/AS) > Customer Requirement > Internal Policy
